scope_note: This seed records the representative plates examined during Council deliberation. It must not be represented as the required whole-library audit. Whole-library enumeration and classification remain a blocking pilot obligation.

dispositions.title: When geometry becomes an engine
dispositions.finding: The static distorted surface/grid and isolated signal do not visibly encode Ricci-flow evolution, metric smoothing, curvature scale, or a sequence approaching singularity.
dispositions.target_representation: simulation-derived or data-derived staged rendering with explicit time, curvature encoding, and vector annotation

dispositions.title: The craft of controlled surgery
dispositions.finding: The planar cut-and-wedge grammar risks teaching a two-dimensional cut rather than a controlled three-dimensional neck modeled on S^2 x I, cutting two-spheres, and attachment of standard caps.
dispositions.target_representation: staged three-dimensional geometric reconstruction with explicit neck, cutting spheres, scale cue, and smooth cap geometry

dispositions.title: The critical strip
dispositions.finding: The plate description promises trivial zeros, the pole, symmetry, and nontrivial zeros, but the visible encoding is only a strip, central line, and generic points. Axes, sigma=0/1/1/2, the pole, trivial zeros, symmetry, and the provenance of nontrivial-zero positions are not carried by the image.
dispositions.target_representation: verified complex-plane/data-derived visualization with exact axes and analytic annotations; optional field view separated from zero-location data

dispositions.title: Energy guards; vorticity stretches
dispositions.finding: The present closed-loop/line motif does not depict a three-dimensional vortex tube, lengthening and thinning, vorticity magnitude, the stretching term, or an energy cascade despite the alt text and caption inviting those readings.
dispositions.target_representation: three-stage vortex-tube rendering or controlled simulation-derived sequence; keep the energy identity and vortex-stretching equation as separately labeled analytic panels

dispositions.title: From subvarieties to classes
dispositions.finding: The circle-to-arrow-to-H^(p,p) grammar is not materially false but is too content-poor to teach the cycle-class map, codimension, rationality, many-to-one behavior, or the conjectural surjectivity boundary.
dispositions.target_representation: rich vector conceptual diagram or worked geometric example with an explicit cycle-class map, coefficient field, codimension, image, and open surjectivity boundary

dispositions.title: The ancient question of rational solutions
dispositions.finding: The documentary prose supplies an exact congruent-number example, but the illustrated cubic and points are presented as visual analogy rather than a verified plot. A reader can mistake aesthetically placed points or curve geometry for literal arithmetic data.
dispositions.target_representation: exact computational plot of E_5: y^2=x^3-25x with verified rational points, including (25/4,75/8), and the genuine rational 5-area triangle with labeled sides 3/2, 20/3, 41/6

dispositions.title: The grammar of reduction
dispositions.finding: A directed mapping between decision problems is intrinsically diagrammatic and the nearby manuscript states the exact relation x in A iff f(x) in B. SVG is an appropriate medium for this representation class, subject to explicit reduction-direction labeling and the new semantic contract.
dispositions.target_representation: retain SVG as the positive-control case; enrich labels only if independent review identifies a concrete pedagogical defect

blocking_next_step: Enumerate every current reader-facing documentary visual from the manifest-discovered editions, bind exact asset identities, and assign KEEP, REDRAW, REPLACE, or RETIRE before the pilot is eligible for completion.
